get.description: Returns the full human resource. blocked_alerts is a read-only derived field. 404 if the human does not exist.

Returns every profile for the human (profile_no, name, area, location, active_hours). active_hours is a typed JSON array of schedule entries ([] when no schedule is set). 404 if the human does not exist.

areas.description: Requested area names; intersected with the human's allowed areas (invalid/duplicate entries dropped)

active_hours.description: New active-hours schedule ([] clears it). Validated against the strict schema.

boss.description: Catch-all for boss encounters: set true to match only boss invasions (stored grunt_type "boss"). One-of mode field. Mutually exclusive with the others; gender not allowed.

clean.description: Auto-delete the alert on expiry (clean bitmask bit 1). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

distance.description: Radius in metres around the anchor location. Omit (or 0) to match by the profile's geofence areas instead of a radius — 0 means area-based, NOT zero metres (stored as 0). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

edit.description: Keep the message updated in place (clean bitmask bit 2). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

everything.description: Catch-all wildcard: set true to match EVERY invasion (stored grunt_type "everything"). This is the 'any invasion' selector — there is no omit-to-wildcard on invasion (exactly one mode field must be set). Mutually exclusive with the others; gender not allowed.

gender.description: Grunt gender filter: any|male|female. Omit to match any gender (defaults to 'any', stored as 0). ONLY valid together with type_id. Returned as null when 'any' (or when not in type_id mode).

grunt_id.description: Game-master grunt id; resolves to its type name and implies its own gender. One-of mode field. Mutually exclusive with type_id/everything/boss; gender not allowed. (On read-back a grunt_id rule is reported as type_id+gender, faithful to what is stored.)

override_areas.description: Restrict this rule to these geofence areas (mutually exclusive with distance > 0 and override_location_label). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

override_location_label.description: Saved-location label to use instead of the profile location (requires distance > 0; mutually exclusive with override_areas). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

summary.description: Route into the summary digest (clean bitmask bit 4). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

template.description: DTS template name. Omit (or empty) to use the server's configured default template (stored as ""). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

type_id.description: Pokemon type id (1-18); grunt_type resolves to that type's lowercased name. EXACTLY ONE mode field required — set this OR grunt_id OR everything OR boss (not omitted-to-wildcard; use everything for the catch-all). Mutually exclusive with grunt_id/everything/boss. In responses, the active mode field is always present; the other mode fields are omitted/null.
